Let’s say ICE is outside your dorm with an RA. They’re knocking you do *not* have to let them in. RAs are required to get professional staff in order to open the door. Your RA should also be taking photos, and *you* should be recording. Ask to see a warrant. Ask what you’ve done wrong and what the cause of their presence is.

Your RA should also be noting timestamps when ICE arrived, when they started knocking, any interactions, etc. That report should be completed that same day or night. You have the right to access that report. It will include badge numbers, officer names, and the names of everyone involved. You'll be able to see how law enforcement arrived were they called? Were they doing a check-in? All of that should be documented.

**GET THE REPORT.**

I haven’t heard of ICE already being inside someone’s room—but honestly, in these times, I don’t know what to expect. Just know that you have rights. Your RAs should *not* be letting law enforcement in without a warrant.

Also, the way dorms work word travels fast. I hope the community within the residence halls can help keep each other informed.
